body.name: Unrestricted primal-dual exchange certificate
body.construction: Fix a dense sequence in \(S\) and start from a finite \(S_1\subset S\). At iteration \(m\), solve the restricted game against \(S_m\) over all \(\delta\in\mathcal D\), choose a restricted saddle \((\delta_m,\pi_m)\), compute \(L_m=b(\pi_m)\) and \(U_m=R(\delta_m)\), and adjoin both the next point of the dense sequence and an endpoint state attaining \(U_m\). A finite run requests a strictly positive tolerance and stops when \(G_m=U_m-L_m\) is no larger than that tolerance; convergence to zero refers only to the infinite sequence, and no finite termination claim is made at tolerance zero.
